polling.title: Polling and retention
polling.interval_note: Find+ never polls faster than every 5 minutes, to avoid rate-limiting your account. Takes effect after Find+ restarts. An environment variable, if one is set, wins over this box, and the value shown then stays the one already in force.
polling.retention_note: Older observations, place visits and group events are deleted automatically once a day. Leave blank to keep everything.

native_detail.label: Show who and where in notifications
native_detail.note: By default, macOS notifications show a generic "Find+ alert" instead of who or where, because notification banners can appear on a locked screen. Turn on notification details in Settings to show the person and place — anyone who can see the screen then sees the same thing.

honesty.findHub: This history consists of locations reported through Google's Find Hub network. Moto Tag uses nearby participating Android devices to report its location. Location updates can therefore be delayed, sparse, or unavailable, and this application should not be treated as real-time emergency or child-safety GPS tracking.
honesty.apple: Apple Find My locations come from nearby Apple devices and can be delayed, sparse or unavailable. Find+ can only query accessories whose keys you hold; genuine AirTags require extracting pairing keys, which most users cannot do.
honesty.alertsLatency: Alerts inherit the network's delay. An arrival or departure may be reported minutes to hours late.
honesty.presenceStale: A tag with no recent fix is stale, not at home and not left behind. Find+ reports it as unknown.
honesty.lockNotEncryption: The app lock stops casual browsing. It does not encrypt the database; anyone with access to this user account or the disk can read it. Use FileVault.
honesty.whatsappRelay: WhatsApp alerts are relayed through CallMeBot, a third-party free service. Your alert text transits CallMeBot's servers before reaching WhatsApp. Delivery is best-effort with no guarantee. Find+ is not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta or CallMeBot.
honesty.whatsappSetup: To connect WhatsApp: add +34 623 91 22 04 to your phone's contacts, then send it the message "I allow callmebot to send me messages" from your own WhatsApp. CallMeBot replies with an API key within about two minutes — paste it below.
honesty.alertsLocked: Notifications are held while Find+ is locked. Unlock to see what you missed.
honesty.nativeGeneric: By default, macOS notifications show a generic "Find+ alert" instead of who or where, because notification banners can appear on a locked screen. Turn on notification details in Settings to show the person and place — anyone who can see the screen then sees the same thing.
honesty.notAffiliated: Find+ is not affiliated with Apple or Google. Find Hub and Find My are their trademarks.
honesty.chromeRequired: Google Chrome was not found on this machine. Google sign-in drives Chrome directly and cannot run without it. Install it from https://www.google.com/chrome/ and try again.
